instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. Inside a gym with grey padded walls and a circular logo, the shirtless man with a mullet (R2) is positioned on the right with his back to the camera, lunging forward in a wide stance to throw a punch. On the left, the man in the black t-shirt (R1) stands facing him defensively, wearing white shin guards and black gloves. Both fighters wear protective eyewear. The background features camera tripods against the wall, with no bystanders present. The scene is illuminated by flat, overhead gym lighting.
